description.content: Manage devices (machines) that have communicated with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Retrieve device information, health status, risk scores, and exposure levels.

Retrieves a collection of machines that have communicated with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Supports OData V4 query parameters including $filter, $top (max 10,000), and $skip. Rate limited to 100 calls per minute and 1,500 calls per hour.

Maximum number of results to return (max 10,000).
